# harmonysase_standard_network (Resource)

Standard Harmony SASE network. Owns its initial region and the gateway(s) born with it. Additional gateways and regions are managed via `harmonysase_gateway`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harmonysase_standard_network" "main" {
  name   = "production-network"
  subnet = "10.255.0.0/16"
  tags   = ["prod"]

  initial_region = {
    harmony_sase_region_id = "eu-west-1"
    scale_units            = 1
    idle                   = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `initial_region` (Attributes) The first region attached to the network. Required at create time and remains the network's seed region. Use `harmonysase_gateway` for any additional regions or gateways. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_region))
- `name` (String) Network name (5–32 characters).

### Optional

- `subnet` (String) CIDR for the network. Defaults to `10.255.0.0/16`. Changing forces replacement.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags applied to the network.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `access_type` (String) `public` or `private`.
- `dns` (String) DNS suffix assigned to the network.
- `id` (String) Network ID assigned by the API.
- `regions` (Attributes Map) All regions attached to this network, keyed by region name as returned by the API (e.g. `"London"`, `"London 2"`). Reference these from sibling resources (e.g. `harmonysase_standard_wireguard_tunnel`) to avoid hardcoding runtime IDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))
- `tenant_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--initial_region"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_region`

Required:

- `harmony_sase_region_id` (String) ID of the SASE region (from the `/harmony-sase-regions` catalogue). Changing forces replacement.

Optional:

- `idle` (Boolean) Create gateways in idle/disabled state. Defaults to false (gateways are active). Changing forces replacement.
- `instance_type` (String) Instance type for the gateways in this region. Changing forces replacement.
- `scale_units` (Number) Number of gateways in this region. Defaults to 1.

Read-Only:

- `gateway_ids` (List of String) IDs of gateways currently in the initial region, sorted ascending. Used as the deterministic order for scale-down victim selection.
- `region_id` (String) Runtime region ID assigned by the API.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `gateways` (Attributes List) Gateways currently in this region, ordered by their runtime ID ascending so positions are stable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions--gateways))
- `id` (String) Runtime region ID.

<a id="nestedatt--regions--gateways"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions.gateways`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harmonysase_standard_network.main <network_id>
```
